research_question: Can annotation selection account jointly for repeated episodes from an animal and the unequal number of episode/photo labels acquired with each animal group?
motivation: Privileged cross-modal disagreement was weaker than RGB diversity at low budgets. Replace uncertain teacher predictions by an explicit label-free coverage objective, with each animal contributing equal total mass.
objective: F(S)=sum_g (1/|E_g|) sum_{i in E_g} max_{j in union_{h in S} E_h} exp(-||z_i-z_j||^2/tau); total selected-group cost sum_h |E_h| cannot exceed the nominal training-label budget. tau is the full unlabeled training-pool median squared RGB distance.
greedy: At each query, choose the affordable group with greatest marginal F gain divided by its number of episode/photo labels; update coverage after every group. Use no unqueried labels or predicted BCS in acquisition.
dairy: No depth data exist, so the RGBD acquisition arm is omitted. Images use their own native 1-5 scale and mean of two raters. This is an independent data-source replication with separate supervised fitting, not a zero-shot cross-scale transfer.
initialisation: Identical random group order across policies within cohort/fold/seed; acquire up to three groups affordable within first budget, without accessing labels; record actual count and cost
predictor: Fixed DINOv2 RGB global features, RBF SVR epsilon=.1, C grid [100,10,1,.1], training-pool median-distance bandwidth multipliers [.5,1,2]; choose settings using acquired labels and fixed validation labels only
cost: All fixed validation reference labels are included in total annotation cost. Beef costs are scoring-episode references; dairy costs are photo-reference pairs averaged across raters. These counts are proxies, not observed annotation minutes, and absolute costs are not compared across cohorts.
primary_endpoint: Mean MAE integrated over actually achieved total annotation-cost fractions [0.5,1.0], divided by .5; interpolate each fold/seed curve without imposing monotonic accuracy
controls: Uniform episode mass versus equal animal mass; marginal-gain-only versus gain-per-label-cost; standard cost-adjusted RGB core set; RGB bootstrap committee plus diversity; random animal groups. All share initial labels and validation/test animal groups.
uncertainty: Paired animal-group bootstrap of seed-averaged integrated out-of-fold event errors; seeds are acquisition repetitions, not independent animals
novelty_scope: Facility location, submodular selection and active learning are established. The candidate is an explicit repeated-animal and unequal-label-cost adaptation for BCS, tested rather than assumed effective. No prospective annotation-time saving or full-score equivalence claim is prespecified.
